notes:
Top-line: Cascade Realtime CX is a digital-first contact center vendor building a managed agent UI used by SMBs and mid-market customers. Evaluation is focused on real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions) with strong SLAs during spikes.

Key requirements (shorthand):
- Streaming suggestions: <200ms median, 95th <400ms for in-session tokens; 99th target depends on concurrency.
- Throughput: baseline 300 concurrent agents; burst to 1,200 agents during campaigns. Need autoscale and graceful throttling/fallback.
- Guardrails: policy hooks for tool-calling; allow whitelist for internal tools, block data exfiltration for PII tokens.
- Ticket summarization: offline batch for nightly summary + inline one-click TL;DR during wrap-up.
- Tool-calling: require deterministic function call semantics and audit logs tied to agent actions.
- Cost sensitivity: product team wants hybrid routing (hosted for steady-state, dedicated during peak campaigns) to control unit economics.
- Compliance: SOC2-ish baseline, require KMS + SSO, signed audit logs for regulatory customers.

Quote/echo from CTO on 2026-02-25 call: 'We need suggestions we can trust at 20ms inference time in-stream — otherwise agents ignore them.' (paraphrase).

POC scope agreed: 48h streaming load test (simulate 1k agents + realistic message length distribution), guardrail tests (function-calling whitelist/deny), integration test with customer KMS stub.

Decision factors: latency SLO proof, deterministic function calling, integration complexity for KMS & SSO, unit cost per conversational turn at scale.

Next steps (short): SE to run streaming POC on Dedicated pool, capture token-level histograms, produce a short SLO report. AE to coordinate budget/legal for roadmap to procurement.

Gated by: security sign-off (KMS), and procurement alignment with predicted ARR.
